For he said,
"Whosoever is shut up

And he was afraid to go to Ahmad.
And while he was thus situated,
a certain emir named Buqa the treasurer,
who was very much beloved by Abaqa, Arghun's father,
said to Ahmad,
"If you promise that you will not harm Arghun,
I will go and bring him to you."
And Ahmad promised with oaths according to the custom of the Mongols
that if Arghun came to him of his own will,
he would do him no harm.
Then that emir Buqa went up quickly to Arghun,
and brought him down from the fortress,
and brought him to Ahmad.
And Ahmad rejoiced in him greatly,
and made a three-day feast.
Then after three days, an evil thought stirred in Ahmad,
and he set guards over Arghun, [namely] Alinaq (and his companions?),
and said to them,
"I am going to Azerbaijan to my mother, Qutui Khatun.
Now, you watch Arghun carefully,
lest he escape;
and bring him to me
wherever I may be."
And on the very night in which he wished to set out,
he revealed his secret to certain of the nobles and said to them,
"If I do not kill Arghun and the rest of the royal princes,
the kingdom will not be established for me."
These things he said,
and in the morning he set out.
And he commanded
that Arghun should be brought to him by very easy stages.
Now when Buqa the emir understood this,
he feigned illness so as not to journey with Ahmad,
and remained until nightfall.
And he went round to all the royal princes,
and made known to them the secret (intention) of Ahmad,
and that he was about to destroy them all.
And zeal seized the royal princes,
and they arose and came by night to Arghun, to the place where he was being guarded.
And they brought him out, and clothed him in chain mail,
and gave him weapons,
and set him on a horse.
And they all went together to where Alinaq was sleeping,
and killed him inside his tent;
and they also killed the other nobles, his companions.
And heralds cried out in the camp of the Mongols,
"The royal princes have killed Alinaq and the other nobles, his companions.

and let no one move or stir from his place {OCR?}."
